Name: DURSOL-FABRIK OTTO DURST GMBH & CO. KG
DESCRIPTION:
At the Dursol-Fabrik Otto Durst GmbH & Co. KG, we have stood for the highest quality and innovation in the field of cleaning and care products for over 90 years. As a traditional family business in its 4th generation based in Solingen, we develop globally recognized solutions for the care and protection of metal surfaces, vehicles, motorcycles, as well as for the marine and industrial sectors under our brand AUTOSOL®. We place great importance on the environmental compatibility of our products: Our proven formulations are free from microplastics and thus actively contribute to environmental protection.

Our product portfolio also includes cleaning agents for the plastics industry, as well as effective cleaning pastes, rust removers, and corrosion protection agents that have been developed for various applications. We are particularly proud of our environmentally friendly formulations, which are free from microplastics and thus actively contribute to environmental protection. Additionally, many of our metal care products are NSF-registered, making them suitable for use in food-related areas as well. This underscores our commitment to the highest purity and safety in all applications.

Our care products are successfully used in over 200 countries and offer tailored solutions for end consumers and businesses. With AUTOSOL®, we stand for brilliant results and the highest quality – recognized and appreciated worldwide.

Name: WALTER SCHMIDT CHEMIE GMBH
DESCRIPTION:
We are manufacturers of chemical products such as AdBlue, vehicle care products (de-icers, antifreeze, etc.), household cleaners, distilled water, and much more under RETAILER’S BRANDING or our own brand Robbyrob.

Our headquarters is located in Berlin, Germany, and our production site is in Vetschau, Brandenburg, just an hour's drive from Berlin.

We have a production site with 400,000 m² of open space, 25,000 m² of covered storage space, and a liquid goods warehouse with a total capacity of over 7 million liters, allowing us to guarantee the supply to our customers throughout the year. Our machinery is continuously being expanded, and we can fill chemicals from 50 ml to 1000 L IBCs. Upon request, we can also provide bulk goods that can be transferred via tank trucks.

Through Walter Schmidt Logistik, which is part of the Walter Schmidt Group alongside Walter Schmidt Zement and Walter Schmidt Chemie, we enjoy all logistical advantages – including in the hazardous goods sector. Furthermore, we have our own rail connection and locomotives, enabling us to source and load large quantities – regardless of weather conditions. This allows us to offer competitive prices without compromising on quality.

Our certifications:
• DIN EN ISO 9001
• DIN EN ISO 14001
• IFS HPC
• RSPO SCC
• A.I.S.E.
• VDA ISO 22241

Name: ZNC SERVICE
DESCRIPTION:
ZNC SERVICE: Sicurezza, Accoglienza e Pulizia su Misura

ZNC Service è una realtà leader nel settore della sicurezza, accoglienza e pulizia, specializzata nell’offrire soluzioni personalizzate per aziende, eventi e organizzazioni. Grazie a un’esperienza decennale e a un team altamente qualificato, garantiamo protezione, professionalità e ambienti impeccabili in ogni contesto, sia lavorativo che di intrattenimento.

La nostra certificazione ISO 9001 testimonia l’eccellenza e l’attenzione ai dettagli che caratterizzano ogni servizio offerto. Operiamo in vari ambiti, fornendo sicurezza per eventi, aziende, hotel, uffici e congressi, oltre a soluzioni dedicate a centri commerciali, musei e parchi divertimento. I nostri servizi di accoglienza, con hostess e steward formati, assicurano un’ospitalità impeccabile per ogni evento.

ZNC Service si distingue anche nella pulizia e cura del verde, trasformando ogni spazio in un ambiente accogliente e rigoglioso. Utilizziamo attrezzature innovative e prodotti di alta qualità per ottimizzare tempi e costi, garantendo un risultato eccezionale.

Disponibili 24 ore su 24, 7 giorni su 7, siamo il partner ideale per chi cerca affidabilità, efficienza e flessibilità. Contattaci oggi per scoprire come possiamo rendere il tuo ambiente sicuro, pulito e memorabile.

Name: AWIWA E.K.
DESCRIPTION:
The family-owned company awiwa® was founded in 2006 by Achim Winkel and produces microbiological cleaning agents that eliminate unpleasant odors and achieve deep cleanliness. The cleaners can be used in various settings, including households, businesses, and public areas. They biologically break down dirt and release odorless substances such as water and air. awiwa® cleaning agents are fully biodegradable and safe for humans, animals, and the environment.

The product range now also includes suitable cleaning accessories, such as microfiber cloths and sponges.

Private Label Products

awiwa also offers versatile contract manufacturing for private label products, ranging from individual services like production, filling, and packaging to a full-service package. We are happy to provide you with detailed advice on this topic and support you in the planning.

Name: INOX VERTRIEBS GMBH
DESCRIPTION:
INOX stands by you as a reliable partner with high innovative strength and chemical expertise, focusing on Made in Germany. Since the registration of our company, we have grown into a leading B2B manufacturer in the areas of Private-Label for additives, lubricants, coolant antifreeze, and specialty chemicals for cleaning processes in the automotive industry as well as in industrial applications.

We emphasize not only developing high-performance products at our in-house production and development sites but also optimizing the working and manufacturing processes of each individual customer. In addition to high quality standards for our products, INOX® also relies on state-of-the-art technology in the filling process and processing. As a powerful, dynamic team, we respond quickly with interesting solutions to your requests.

Quality
Providing the highest quality and ensuring customer satisfaction is our most important goal. In addition to sales, INOX® - Vertrieb invests a lot of passion in the further development and improvement of our products to ensure a high standard of quality.

To maintain these quality standards, our products undergo regular quality controls by independent testing institutes. INOX® - Vertrieb regularly expands its product range and adapts it to market conditions, so you can trust that you will always find the right products for your application with us.
